r'(s, a, s') = r(s, a, s') + F(s, s')

# A common choice: distance-based shaping
def shaped_reward(reward, state, next_state, gamma=0.99):
    phi_s = -distance_to_goal(state)
    phi_s_next = -distance_to_goal(next_state)
    shaping = gamma * phi_s_next - phi_s   # potential-based
    return reward + shaping
caption: F(s,s') = γΦ(s') − Φ(s) is potential-based shaping
